title: Pray Hard & Speak Life: Finding Hope in the Midst of: Addictions Bankruptcy Suicide Cancer
author: Jill Kelly
target_audience: Individuals facing personal or family struggles such as addiction, illness, or financial crisis
Those seeking encouragement, inspiration, or spiritual guidance
Christian readers looking for testimonies of faith in adversity
core_themes: Hope and faith in times of crisis
Speaking words of encouragement and life over hardship
primary_purpose: To offer hope and encouragement to readers navigating severe life challenges by sharing personal stories of perseverance, faith, and the healing power of prayer and positive speech.

structure_format.organization: Divided into thematic chapters, each focused on a life challenge (addiction, bankruptcy, suicide, cancer), interwoven with personal stories and practical faith-based advice

key_concepts_lessons: Honest confrontation of one’s struggles invites hope and healing.
Prayer is a powerful tool for endurance and transformation.
The words spoken—to ourselves and others—hold power to shape outcomes and perspectives.
Faith does not guarantee easy resolutions, but provides enduring strength and comfort.
It is possible to move from despair to hope, regardless of the circumstances.
notable_features: Addresses a range of hardships including addiction, bankruptcy, suicide, and cancer
Strong emphasis on the role of speech and prayer in healing
Accessible to readers regardless of where they are on their faith journey
cultural_historical_context: Published in the early 2020s, the book arises in a social climate where mental health, addiction, and personal finance crises are openly discussed. It reflects contemporary Christian approaches to suffering and resilience, emphasizing authenticity and spiritual practice.
reception_impact: Praised for its raw honesty and relatability
Widely shared in faith-based and recovery communities
Utilized in support groups, church studies, and personal devotion
Recognized for destigmatizing difficult topics such as suicide and addiction through a Christian lens
